The official record

The Timeline

Only the milestones that shape WWF history: major PLEs, championships, inaugural programs and landmark additions. Tap an event to expand its original artwork and details.

January 1, 1984EstablishedOne World Wrestling FederationTap to reveal the original announcement+

Vince McMahon brings the major wrestling territories under one WWF banner. No rival promotions exist in this alternate universe; WWF remains the permanent name.

January 2, 1984 • Boston GardenFirst BroadcastBattlegrounds #001Tap to reveal the inaugural show and original photos+

WWF Battlegrounds opens its Monday night era at Boston Garden, with Mean Gene Okerlund overseeing the show. The first night includes Bret Hart's WWF debut against British Bulldog, an acclaimed four-star encounter, and King Kong Bundy's brutal Falls Count Anywhere victory over Junkyard Dog.

Additional documented matches featured Tully Blanchard vs. Jimmy Snuka, Tito Santana vs. Greg Valentine, Rocky Johnson vs. Michael Hayes, Tony Atlas vs. Ole Anderson, and a Dynamite Kid victory. Kerry Von Erich vs. Terry Funk was canceled.

January 6, 1984 • MiamiFirst PLE / First ChampionThe Realignment RumbleAndré becomes champion in a 5/5-star classic+

The WWF's first major PLE crowns its inaugural unified-era WWF Undisputed World Heavyweight Champion. André the Giant wins the 20-man Royal Rumble, eliminating Stan Hansen last; Bob Backlund is also among the final three.

The Rumble earns a perfect 5/5 stars and is also preserved in the dedicated Classics collection.

January 7, 1984 • Madison Square GardenFirst Broadcast / CelebrationPrime Time #001André's championship celebration with Vince McMahon+

The first Saturday Night Prime Time marks the official celebration of André the Giant's new Undisputed World Heavyweight Championship. Vince McMahon joins André for the historic celebration at Madison Square Garden.

The previously booked card included Ricky Steamboat vs. Larry Zbyszko, Randy Savage vs. Pedro Morales, Hulk Hogan vs. Big John Studd (No Holds Barred co-main event), and Bob Backlund vs. The Iron Sheik (Steel Cage main event). Their outcomes are not recorded in this historical summary.

About WWF Universe

This is an independent, fan-created WWE 2K26 Universe Mode alternate-history archive beginning January 1, 1984. In this fictional timeline, Vince McMahon unifies the major territories into the WWF, and WWF never changes its name. Confirmed match results come from gameplay; unplayed matches and proposed stories are identified as such. This website is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WWE, 2K, or any rights holder. Trademarks and character likenesses remain the property of their respective owners.
